title: Record overlay (kanban, calendar, gantt, tree): save refusals, field hints and conflict rows show the field's machine name instead of its label
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding while building #35995 (PR #36298, os-dev-report 7074757038 on #35995, PR `## Acceptance notes`), confirmed by the L1-d review (ACCEPT 7074798693, "Out-of-scope items 1"). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.
Dedupe: `fieldLabelFor` (open: 1 hit, #35995 itself), `overlay machine name field` (open: 5 hits; #35995 #30806 #25921 #6015 and none on this). No card covers it.

## What happens (read on `origin/main` 4ab12189; not driven in a browser)

- `InlineEditSaveBar` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`) labels a field through its `fieldLabelFor` prop and falls back to the name: `(name) => fieldLabelFor?.(name) || name`.
- The record page passes it (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `fieldLabelFor={(name) => objectDef?.fields?.[name]?.label || fieldLabel(objectName, name, name)}`).
- `RecordDetailPanel` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailPanel.tsx`), the record overlay of kanban, calendar, gantt and tree, passes none. So a per-field refusal in the overlay already reads with the machine name (for example `loss_reason`) on main.
- After PR #36298 (#35995) the overlay's bar also gets `data`, so the same refusals now draw as field hints, and the new conflict dialog's rows fall back to the field name too: the gap is wider.

reach: any user saving a field in the overlay of a kanban, calendar, gantt or tree view whose save is refused or meets a 409. Not measured live.

## Ask

- The overlay labels fields the way the record page does: the field's (translated) label, falling back to the name only when no label exists. The bar already reads `objectFields` from the record context `RecordDetailPanel` now provides, so a label fallback there (or passing `fieldLabelFor` from the panel) covers the refusal line, the field hint and the conflict rows. ⛔ No second labelling rule.
- Pins: a refused save in the overlay names the field by its label; a conflict row names it by its label; CONTROL a field with no label still shows its name.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` expected.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail`, record overlay) · area:ux · Bug.
